Yahoo Sports now exposes a full attributable Josh Pate Ohio State-Texas clip transcript. Pate says both offensive lines may be net disadvantages against the opposing fronts, doubts either side consistently creates ground-game chunk yardage, identifies tight-end usage/personnel as overlooked, and says elite receivers could decide a low-total game with one or two explosive plays. He references a 48.5 total and says he could see the game going under, but does not state an Under wager in the accessible clip.

Yahoo Sports exposes an attributable Josh Pate Oklahoma-Michigan clip transcript/summary. Pate frames Bryce Underwood as entering a high-pressure spot against Brent Venables' Oklahoma defense after Michigan produced little offensive foundation in Week 1, with home-crowd pressure capable of worsening an early offensive stall. No ATS/ML/total wager or price is stated in the accessible evidence.

Yahoo Sports exposes an attributable Josh Pate Alabama-Kentucky clip transcript. Pate explicitly references Alabama -10.5 at Kentucky, notes Kalen DeBoer is 7-5 straight up as a double-digit road favorite and 4-8 ATS as a ranked road favorite, and argues Kentucky in Week 2 is a different proposition from Kentucky later in the season because the Wildcats are healthy, undefeated and will have an engaged Lexington crowd. He explicitly leaves open the possibility that Alabama has reached a new gear and does not state a Kentucky ATS or ML wager.
